From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence
even of your lusts that war in your members ?

even of your lusts that war in your members ?

你们贪恋，还是得不着；
你们杀害嫉妒，又斗殴争战，
也不能得。你们得不着，
是因为你们不求。
你們貪戀，還是得不着；
你們殺害嫉妒，又鬥毆爭戰，
也不能得。你們得不着，
是因為你們不求。

and have not : ye kill
and desire to have
and cannot obtain : ye fight and war
yet ye have not
because ye ask not .

You lust
and don’t have. You murder and covet
and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have
because you don’t ask.
You are burning with desire
and have not your desire
so you put men to death; you are full of envy
and you are not able to get your desire
so you are fighting and making war; you have not your desire
because you do not make request for it.
你们求也得不着，是因为你们妄求，
要浪费在你们的宴乐中。
你們求也得不着，是因為你們妄求，
要浪費在你們的宴樂中。
Ye ask
and receive not
because ye ask amiss
that ye may consume it upon your lusts .

because your request has been wrongly made
